title: freeipa: Add support for subUIDs and subGIDs
reason: Coordinator's PR title says 'freeipa' but the real diff (via the Compare API, filtered to nixos/modules/services/) lands entirely in sssd.nix, not a freeipa.nix module -- NixOS's freeipa support is implemented via sssd, so subUID/subGID integration was added there directly as a real new mkOption 'subIDsIntegration'.
targets_toml: option_prefix=[services,sssd], watch=[subIDsIntegration]. Test 'sssd-ldap.nix' is the real test that enables services.sssd (no dedicated bare 'sssd.nix' test exists in the corpus; 'sssd-legacy-config.nix' also exists as a sibling).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: REAL ACTIONABLE FINDING: uncovered option branch, no test assignment flips 'subIDsIntegration' away from its default false. Mechanically verified: two real predicate_attempts (Truthy mkIf form and explicit Eq-true form), both witnessed=false. New OBA001 finding this batch -- the 3rd in this single batch (alongside navidrome's environmentFile and greetd's useTextGreeter).
